name: Laguna Torre
region: Los Glaciares National Park, north sector
why: The gentler of the two great El Chaltén walks: a long valley to a lake with icebergs under Cerro Torre's needle.
water: Streams along the way; nothing to buy after the village.
dangers: Cerro Torre hides in cloud most days: go on the clearest morning you have.
The last stretch on the moraine is open to a cold wind off the glacier.
turnaround: Leave the lake by 15:00 to be back before dark in spring and autumn.

points.name: Laguna Torre trailhead, El Chaltén
points.note: At the west end of Calle Los Cohihues. The first 20 minutes are the steepest of the day.

points.name: Mirador del Torre
points.note: After about 3 km: the whole valley and, if it is clear, Cerro Torre at its end.

points.name: Campamento De Agostini
points.note: The camp in the lenga forest, with toilets. The lake is 10 minutes up the moraine.

points.name: Laguna Torre
points.note: 630 m, on the moraine above the lake: icebergs from the Glaciar Grande. Mirador Maestri is 1 h more along the moraine crest to the right.
